purpose: Continue targeted closure after pass 03 with fresh official-source checks for Goirle, Goeree-Overflakkee and Gilze en Rijen, while preserving unresolved Goes/Gorinchem items for one more final sweep.

newFindings: Current municipal Omgevingsvergunning page confirms Omgevingsloket permit check and application with DigiD/eHerkenning.
A concept request is explicitly recommended and can be filed through Omgevingsloket.

Current concept-request package is concrete: cadastral site plan scale 1:500 or 1:1000; existing and proposed drawings with floor plans/use, sections, elevations including adjacent buildings, details, destinations, materials, colours and major installations at scale 1:100; photos of existing situation and surroundings; clear project description.
Current concept-request fee for 2026 is EUR 625.25 and is credited against the final permit if applied for within 26 weeks.
Neighbourhood participation/omgevingsgesprek is explicitly part of preparation and a report should record time/place, invitees and attendees.

Official council material still points historically to a 2015 room-rental policy, but no current publication/successor was positively found in the final search. Therefore current legal permission is driven by the Omgevingsplan/BOPA route, with the old policy retained only as historical policy-direction evidence.
remainingAllowedOnly: successor/currentness of the 2015 room-rental policy if a later official publication surfaces
exact final permit tariff for the selected branch

newFindings: Current Beleidsregel afwijkingen omgevingsplan Goeree-Overflakkee is effective from 22-05-2025 and provides a current BOPA assessment framework.
That policy explicitly contemplates temporary housing in connection with new-build including woningsplitsing, confirming that woningsplitsing is an active project type in current spatial practice.

Current Omgevingsvisie Goeree-Overflakkee is effective from 11-02-2026 and explicitly states the municipality wants to use the existing housing stock more flexibly through woningsplitsing, woningdelen and related forms.
The 2026 Omgevingsvisie also says these ambitions will be translated into future Omgevingsplan rules and programs, creating a concrete future-law/currentness signal.
Current application route/8-week framework from prior pass remains valid.
records.futureSignal: Translate 2026 Omgevingsvisie ambitions for woningsplitsing/woningdelen into future Omgevingsplan rules/programs; recheck when those rules are adopted.

newFindings: Current Programma wonen explicitly states that the municipality intends to facilitate/stimulate some forms of woningdelen and woningsplitsing.
Measure 11 explicitly orders preparation of an afwegingskader for woningsplitsing and verkamering, intended to weigh housing need more strongly against parking and urban-design constraints.

A fresh official-source search did not positively surface a formally adopted current afwegingskader yet. Therefore the program is retained as a concrete policy-development signal, not treated as if the detailed framework already exists.
remainingAllowedOnly: future adoption/publication of the announced afwegingskader
current address-specific Omgevingsplan/BOPA assessment in the interim

records.result: Repeated official-source searches continue to confirm the distinct application channels but did not yet surface a reliable current generic municipality-wide substantive housing-stock regulation in a stable public source. This is not yet classified as permanently unfindable; one final direct current Omgevingsplan/integrated-component sweep remains required before closure.

Current opkoopbescherming remains closed and current. Repeated searches did not yet positively expose a current standalone citywide room-rental/splitting rule. Before accepting address-specific classification, one final direct Omgevingsplan/integrated-component sweep is still required.

materialImprovements: Goirle complete current concept-request document package plus EUR 625.25 2026 fee
Goeree-Overflakkee current BOPA policy plus 2026 future-law direction
Gilze en Rijen announced afwegingskader positively retained as future-policy signal
summary.next: Run the final direct Omgevingsplan/integrated-component sweep for Goes and Gorinchem, then close first-five residuals in Geldrop-Mierlo, Gemert-Bakel and Gennep and perform the mandatory 10/10 final sweep.
